name: Blade
description: Blade is a website template for barbershops, with the next free slot and each barber's earliest time right in the hero, a three step booking where the visitor picks a barber, a service and a time while a summary card keeps the price and duration, a price list with the time of each service, a gallery of cuts from the shop, products from the shelf and a location section. Dark green and cream with bold Bricolage Grotesque headings give the website a sharp, confident character. Replace the copy, photos, barbers, prices, booking slots and reviews with your own before publishing.
features: Hero with the next free slot and each barber's earliest time today
Three step booking: barber, service and time, with a summary card
Price list with the duration of each service
Service pages with the visit step by step and a recommended barber
Gallery of cuts from the shop
Products from the shelf with prices
Customer reviews, to be replaced with genuine testimonials
Location section with opening hours and a map link
